en.name: Al-Hadikhia
en.ability: Each night*, you may choose 3 players (all players learn who): each silently chooses to live or die, but if all live, all die.

zh.name: 哈迪寂亚
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你可以选择三名玩家（所有玩家会得知你选了谁）：他们分别秘密决定自己的生死，然后如果他们都存活则都死亡。
